I am an old woman here in Mbeya, and my strength is not what it used to be. This small piece of land I work with my own hands, and with help from my grandchildren when they are not at school. I cannot afford the chemical fertilizer from the shop, it is too expensive for a widow like me, but I put the manure from my few goats and chickens on the field. I keep the seeds from last year's harvest like my mother taught me, and I pray for good rains because I have no way to bring water to the field.
